summary: Saint Lucia's Department of External Affairs visa list marks citizens of the UK, the US, Canada, China and EU member states, among others, as needing no visa. EU citizens may stay up to 90 days in any 180-day period under the EU waiver agreement; the UK and Canadian governments say their citizens can stay up to six weeks, and the UK says to apply to the Immigration Department in Castries to extend. No official source we could read gives the length of stay for other visa-free passports. The list marks Barbados, Jamaica and Trinidad and Tobago as needing no visa and Haiti as needing one. Citizens of other listed countries and territories, including India, need a visa the list marks as issued at the port of entry, and those it marks "prior to arrival" need the visa before they arrive; no official source we could read says where that visa is issued.

passportValidity.text: No official Saint Lucian source we could read states a passport-validity rule. Canada's travel advice says the passport must be valid for at least 3 months beyond the date you expect to leave Saint Lucia; the UK's says it must have an expiry date after the day you plan to leave.

vaccinations.text: The UK Foreign Office says you must have a yellow fever vaccination certificate if you are coming from a country listed as a transmission risk. WHO's country list gives the requirement for travellers aged 9 months or over arriving from countries with risk of yellow fever transmission.

source.name: UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office — St Lucia travel advice: entry requirements

travelInsurance.text: No official source we could read makes insurance an entry condition. The UK's travel advice says medical treatment in Saint Lucia can be expensive and serious cases may need emergency evacuation, and advises adequate travel health insurance; Tapion Hospital does not accept travel or foreign medical insurance as payment.

source.name: UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office — St Lucia travel advice: health

onwardTicket.text: No official source we could read states whether a return or onward ticket is required. Canada's travel advice says customs officials may ask you to show a return or onward ticket and proof that you have a place to stay.

proofOfFunds.text: No official source we could read states whether proof of funds is required, or a minimum amount. Canada's travel advice says customs officials may ask for proof that you have sufficient funds for the duration of your stay.

The portal says to access it no more than 72 hours before travel, submit one form per family or group, and present the receipt emailed after submission on arrival; the UK government tells British travellers to fill it in no more than 3 days before they arrive.

safety.text: Canada's travel advice says to take normal security precautions in Saint Lucia. It reports that violent crime, including gun violence, has increased over the past year, particularly in Vieux Fort, and that petty crime such as pickpocketing and purse snatching rises around festivals, carnival and the winter holiday season.

bestTimeToVisit.text: No official source we could read gives a best time to visit Saint Lucia. Canada's travel advice says the hurricane season runs from early June to the end of November.

idp.text: Saint Lucia's Motor Vehicles and Road Traffic Act (section 30, Revised Laws of Saint Lucia, published by the Attorney General's Chambers) says the Licensing Authority may issue a visitor's driving permit to a visitor who holds a valid licence issued in his or her country of residence; the permit is valid for not more than 3 months and authorises driving only the category of vehicle that licence allows. Section 30A exempts a citizen of a Protocol Member State who holds a valid driver's licence issued by a Protocol Member State, confirming his or her nationality, from any requirement to obtain a visitor's driving permit, and the Government of Saint Lucia says OECS citizens no longer need a visitor's driving permit. No official source we could read states whether an International Driving Permit is required.

tips.text: EU citizens may stay 90 days in any 180-day period under the EU agreement, but the UK and Canadian governments say their citizens can stay up to six weeks. The UK Foreign Office says that to extend your stay you must go to the Immigration Department in Castries.
The UK government says it is illegal for anyone in Saint Lucia, including children, to dress in camouflage clothing.
Traffic drives on the left, according to Canada's travel advice, and the UK government says visitors without a Saint Lucian driving licence must get a temporary driving permit.

faq.question: Do I need a visa for Saint Lucia?
faq.answer: It depends on your passport. Saint Lucia's visa list marks citizens of the UK, the US, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, China and EU member states, among others, as needing no visa, and marks Barbados, Jamaica and Trinidad and Tobago the same way. Citizens of other listed countries and territories, including India, Kenya, Malaysia, Thailand and Vietnam, need a visa the list marks as issued at the port of entry. Nationalities the list marks "prior to arrival" need the visa before they arrive; no official source we could read says where it is issued.

faq.question: How long can I stay in Saint Lucia without a visa?
faq.answer: It depends on your passport. EU citizens may stay up to 90 days in any 180-day period under the EU–Saint Lucia waiver agreement, and Saint Lucia's visa list gives Norwegians and Swiss the same. The UK and Canadian governments say their citizens can stay up to six weeks. For other visa-free passports no official source we could read gives a figure. The UK Foreign Office says that to extend your stay you must go to the Immigration Department in Castries.

faq.question: Is there an arrival form for Saint Lucia?
faq.answer: Yes — the online Embarkation/Disembarkation (ED) form, which replaced the handwritten form from 30 November 2022. The portal says to access it no more than 72 hours before travel, submit one form per family or group, and present the receipt emailed after submission on arrival.

faq.question: Is camouflage clothing really banned in Saint Lucia?
faq.answer: The UK government says it is illegal for anyone, including children, to dress in camouflage clothing in Saint Lucia.

faq.question: Do I need a yellow fever certificate for Saint Lucia?
faq.answer: Only if you are coming from a country listed as a yellow fever transmission risk, according to the UK Foreign Office; WHO's country list sets the requirement for travellers aged 9 months or over arriving from such countries.

faq.question: Does CARICOM free movement apply in Saint Lucia?
faq.answer: Saint Lucia's visa list does not group countries as CARICOM. It marks citizens of Barbados, Jamaica and Trinidad and Tobago as needing no visa, and Haitians as needing one. No official source we could read states the length of stay they are granted.

(3) A visitor's driving permit authorizes the permit holder to drive only the category of vehicle that the permit holder is authorised to drive under the licence issued in the person's country of residence.
